Together the enduring emblem and planned celebration contrasted with the prolonged physical absence give the symbols a new memorial character unspoken by any unit alone.
interpretations.limitations: The units do not show how residents interpret the seal or festival, whether the festival will be cancelled or altered, or whether the seal will be changed.
interpretations.relationship: contrast between enduring symbolic celebration of union and physical absence that prevents its enactment
interpretations.statement: With the physical link gone and its centenary procession impossible for years, the footbridge persists only as an emblem of union and planned celebration, turning symbols of living connection into reminders of division.

support.contributes: Provides the symbolic meaning of the bridge as union of the banks and reconciliation.
Provides the planned celebratory enactment of that union as a procession across the bridge.
Establishes the physical referent of both symbol and celebration has been carried away.
Establishes the absence will last years, preventing enactment of the procession.
